answer.rationale: P99 latency spike correlates temporally with release 2 hours ago during peak settlement traffic. Memory_b1 documents that rolling back a problematic release cleared an error spike without customer impact. Verifying b1 confirms rollback feasibility and speed. Regional failover (b2) requires investigating root cause first. Circuit breakers (b4) are defensive but won't address the underlying latency driver. Read replica routing (b5) helps query load but settlement is write-heavy. Capacity addition (b3) is slow relative to the 90-minute degradation window. Rollback is the highest-confidence recovery path: it's reversible, has precedent in stable prior build behavior, and can execute during peak load without requiring architectural changes. Starting with a rollback preserves the ability to pivot to other interventions if needed.
